proceduralFinding.description: A diagnostic command accidentally serialized the full globalMAIN and sameTopicMAIN objects to stdout while inspecting inventory structure. The tool response was truncated/omitted by the execution layer; the command violated the task instruction against inventory dumps.
proceduralFinding.followup: Do not repeat the dump. Preserve the original output event and this finding; candidate/sourceproof/peer-snapshot and all captured raw source files remain unchanged.
